slides.title: Public-Private Cooperation in the Port of Rotterdam: An Agent-Based Toy Model of Cooperative Efforts Against Cocaine Trafficking
slides.highlight: This paper uses an Agent-Based Model to analyze public-private cooperation dynamics, demonstrating that coordinated multi-parameter strategies significantly outperform isolated measures in governance contexts. It is relevant to MIMIC for its insights into modeling complex interactions between trust, enforcement, and cooperation in hybrid societal systems.

card.one_liner: Agent-based model shows coordinated multi-parameter strategies outperform isolated measures in port anti-drug cooperation.
card.key_idea: Coupled agent-based and causal loop model simulates public-private cooperation dynamics, testing parameter shocks on trust, enforcement, and skills.
card.evaluation: Simulated five-year scenarios using empirical Rotterdam data; coordinated strategies yielded 25% effectiveness gain versus 13% for isolated cooperation.
card.limitation: Exploratory toy model lacking validation against real-world test cases or additional expert input.

slides.title: EvoMisty: Building, Optimizing, and Evolving Capabilities on a Social Robot
slides.highlight: This work introduces a framework for social robots to autonomously build, optimize, and reuse capabilities via coding agents, addressing the need for adaptive embodied learning in human-robot interaction.

card.one_liner: EvoMisty enables coding agents to autonomously build, optimize, and evolve robot capabilities from documentation.
card.key_idea: A plugin framework where agents construct verified atomic capabilities, solve tasks, iteratively optimize metrics, and distill reusable skills.
card.evaluation: Tested on Misty II with Claude Code and Codex; completed 35 tasks, improved 7 metrics, and demonstrated cross-task skill reuse.
card.limitation: Validated only on Misty II; relies on human feedback for verification and final performance depends on initial agent implementation.

slides.title: Realbotix launches humanoid robots for education, wellness and companionship
slides.highlight: Realbotix has introduced humanoid robots designed for education, wellness, and companionship, aligning with the goals of embodied social robotics and human-robot interaction.

slides.title: Bias Cascade: Understanding the Gap Between Knowledge Alignment and Effect Replication in LLM-based Social Simulation
slides.tldr: LLMs fail to replicate collective social effects despite accurate knowledge alignment
slides.highlight: This paper introduces the 'bias cascade' concept and the REFLEX benchmark to demonstrate that LLM-based agents often fail to reproduce macro-level social outcomes even when individual knowledge is aligned. This is relevant to MIMIC as it highlights critical limitations in current agent models for simulating societal-scale dynamics and collective behavior.

card.one_liner: LLMs align with social knowledge but fail to replicate collective effects due to bias cascades in simulation.
card.key_idea: Introduces REFLEX benchmark to compare knowledge judgment with effect simulation, demonstrating that micro-level alignment fails to produce macro-level causal fidelity.
card.evaluation: Evaluated 8 LLMs on 30 counterfactual tasks; best model scored 0.847 in knowledge but only 0.453 in effect simulation, revealing a significant gap.
card.limitation: Current LLMs remain inadequate for reliably simulating collective human behavior, as knowledge alignment does not translate to faithful effect replication.

slides.title: BEARING: Who Is Talking to Whom? Grounding Acoustic Direction in Vision for Online Multi-Party Conversation
slides.tldr: ONLINE ACOUSTIC-VISUAL DIRECTION FUSION FOR MULTI-PARTY CONVERSATION
slides.highlight: BEARING introduces a geometry-first approach that fuses acoustic direction from microphone arrays with visual cues to enable online speaker and addressee identification in multi-party settings. This method supports HyECHO's goals of non-data-hungry multimodal social perception by providing a label-free calibration mechanism and verifiable rewards for robust diarization and engagement modeling.

card.one_liner: BEARING uses microphone array direction as a visual prompt and verifiable reward to improve online multi-party speaker identification.
card.key_idea: Registers acoustic direction into camera frames to prompt VLMs, fuses with visual cues for co-located speakers, and aligns models via geometry-based rewards.
card.evaluation: Tested on AMI, EasyCom, and AVDIAR; direction prompts raised speaker accuracy by 20.6%, and verifiable rewards outperformed self-evaluation baselines.
card.limitation: Addressee detection remains difficult due to linguistic ambiguity, and online registration learning causes initial accuracy dips before stabilizing.

slides.title: YYForce Launches Six Seven Humanoid Concierge for Novotel Singapore
slides.highlight: The deployment of YYForce's Six Seven humanoid as a concierge at Novotel Singapore illustrates real-world applications of embodied social robots in hospitality, relevant to RwB's focus on human-robot interaction and AI-mediated embodied learning.

slides.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon
slides.highlight: Google has released Gemini 4 Neon, a new mid-tier AI model.

slides.title: DiaCap: Jointly Learning Who Speaks When for Audiovisual Dialogue Captioning
slides.highlight: This work introduces DiaCap, an audiovisual LLM that jointly learns speaker identity, timing, and visual descriptions for dialogue captioning, directly addressing the coupled nature of diarization and utterance timing relevant to HyECHO's goal of modeling hybrid human-AI team states.

card.one_liner: DiaCap jointly learns utterance timing and audiovisual diarization via SFT and RL for precise dialogue captioning.
card.key_idea: Unifies timing and speaker attribution in one model, trained on 225K synthetic clips then refined via RL with fine-grained rewards.
card.evaluation: Tested on DiaDemBench; outperforms Gemini 4 Argon in timestamp accuracy (76.59 vs 42.76) and matches diarization performance.
card.limitation: Struggles with small/distant faces and relies on external transcripts, though end-to-end variant reduces this dependency.

slides.title: Sarvam AI Releases Open-Weight 105B Checkpoint for Enterprise Agents
slides.highlight: Sarvam AI has released an open-weight 105B parameter checkpoint designed for enterprise agents, offering a large-scale model option for business applications.

slides.title: EMIP: Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform
slides.highlight: EMIP provides a virtual environment for studying cooperation between humans and embodied AI agents, supporting concurrent speech and physical actions. This aligns with RwB's focus on embodied social robots and human-robot interaction by offering a reusable platform for multi-party collaboration research.

card.one_liner: EMIP is a Minecraft-based platform enabling concurrent speech and physical interaction among multiple humans and AI agents.
card.key_idea: A client-server architecture using Model Context Protocol interfaces for observation, action, and full-duplex audio to support multi-party embodied cooperation.
card.evaluation: Not clearly stated; the paper describes platform features and usage examples but lacks quantitative benchmarks or comparative results.
card.limitation: Performance speedup is constrained by LLM inference, audio processing, and human response times, limiting real-time scalability.

slides.title: NVIDIA AI Releases Nemotron-Labs-Sigma Continuous Diffusion Language Model
slides.highlight: NVIDIA AI has released Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, a continuous diffusion language model available in 3B and 8B parameter sizes with 14 checkpoints.

slides.title: Speaker Attribution and Ideological Congruence in LLM Personas Reading Posts on X
slides.highlight: This study demonstrates that LLM personas exhibit systematic, value-congruent biases when evaluating political speakers, mirroring human ideological congruence effects. This is relevant to HyECHO as it highlights the importance of modeling speaker identity and audience alignment in synthetic social perception tasks.

card.one_liner: LLM personas penalize political posts based on speaker identity, mirroring human ideological congruence.
card.key_idea: Fully crossed speaker-attribution experiment using value-grounded personas to measure stance shifts when identical posts are attributed to different leaders.
card.evaluation: 322k persona-post quartets from X posts; compared against 48 CIS barometers; metrics include stance deltas and ideological congruence contrasts.
card.limitation: Alignment is ordinal and dated to model's knowledge cutoff; personas are not substitutes for real public opinion surveys.

slides.title: ClusterVAD: Threshold-Free Unsupervised Voice Activity Detection with Pre-Trained Neural Representations
slides.tldr: UNSUPERVISED VAD VIA FROZEN SPEECH FOUNDATION MODELS
slides.highlight: ClusterVAD demonstrates that frozen speech foundation model representations can enable robust, unsupervised voice activity detection without labeled data or hand-crafted features, addressing challenges in noisy and far-field environments relevant to social perception pipelines.

card.one_liner: ClusterVAD uses frozen speech foundation model representations and sonority-based clustering for robust, unsupervised voice activity detection.
card.key_idea: Clusters whitened SSL features from auxiliary data, labels clusters via sonority, and applies threshold-free HMM decisions for frame-level speech probability.
card.evaluation: Tested on 12 diverse benchmarks (AMI, AliMeeting, Torgo, etc.) using DetER and Event-F1; outperforms supervised baselines on pause-level references.
card.limitation: Higher computational cost than compact detectors, less reliable on short utterances, and lacks speaker-aware pause merging for turn-level references.

slides.title: Knocking on Minds Door; A Mixed-Methods Field Study of a Voice LLM Companion in Older Adults Daily Lives
slides.tldr: VOICE LLM COMPANION FOR OLDER ADULTS
slides.highlight: This study demonstrates how voice-based LLM companions with persona, memory, and structured conversation rules can reduce emotional loneliness in older adults, offering insights relevant to HyECHO's focus on social perception and engagement modeling.

card.one_liner: Voice LLM companion reduces loneliness and depression in older adults through proactive, memory-rich phone-style calls.
card.key_idea: Phone-call-style agent with persona, proactive initiation, and temporal knowledge graph memory for personalized, sustained conversations.
card.evaluation: Two-week field study with 33 Korean older adults; mixed methods including call logs, UCLA/SGDS scales, and interviews.
card.limitation: No control group limits causal claims; turn-taking difficulties and latency issues persisted despite design adjustments.

slides.title: LanceDB Raises $57.5M Series B to Scale Multimodal AI Data Infrastructure
slides.tldr: LANCEDB SECURES $57.5M SERIES B FOR MULTIMODAL AI DATA
slides.highlight: LanceDB has raised $57.5M in a Series B round to scale its multimodal AI data infrastructure, providing potential backend support for handling the diverse data streams required for hybrid human-AI social perception.

slides.title: Honest but Wrong: Formalizing Retraction in the Ethics of Speech Acts
slides.highlight: This work formalizes the ethical duty to retract false assertions, offering a framework relevant to modeling how AI agents in HyECHO should handle corrections and maintain accurate shared beliefs within hybrid teams.

card.one_liner: Formalizes retraction duties for honest but false assertions using deontological and consequentialist logic.
card.key_idea: Extends belief-based speech act evaluation with FIPA-ACL disconfirm, adding a persistent honesty maxim to deontologism.
card.evaluation: Implemented in Answer Set Programming; tested on a legal-advice case showing deontologism and consequentialism diverge on late retractions.
card.limitation: Assumes speaker's later beliefs are given inputs rather than derived from observations; ignores nested beliefs.

slides.title: Read My Lips: Context-aware Lip Reading Using Language and Audio-Visual Models
slides.highlight: This work demonstrates how combining lip reading, language models, and audio-visual generation can recover speech in noisy or partially observable conditions, directly supporting HyECHO's goal of robust multimodal social perception in hybrid human-AI teams.

card.one_liner: RML combines lip reading, language models, and audio-visual generation to restore corrupted speech.
card.key_idea: Collaborative framework using lip readers for hypotheses, LLMs for context, and AV generators for reconstruction, with adaptive evidence-based selection.
card.evaluation: Tested on TalkVid and VoxMM across noise, silence, and hard-to-read lips; outperforms baselines in WER and span recovery.
card.limitation: Performance relies on lip reader accuracy; selection may fail when visual evidence is unreliable or ambiguous.
